responsibility: Implements the Rust typechecker’s unification engine over TyTy nodes. It drives kind-specific unification between expected and actual types, respects trait-bound compatibility before attempting structural matches, handles inference-variable commitment and propagation of resolved results back through all linked references in TypeCheckContext, and emits the standard type-mismatch diagnostic when no valid unified type can be produced.
same_name_distinction: Implements the unification logic declared in rust-unify.h. Unlike the header, this .cc contains the dispatcher over TyTy::TypeKind, the per-kind expect_* matching routines, inference-variable commitment back into TypeCheckContext, trait-bound prechecks, and type-mismatch diagnostic emission.
